pairs: Now the earth was of one language
And when they were advancing from the east,
they found a plain in the land of Shinar,
And each one said to his neighbor,
And they had bricks instead of stones,
let us make a city and a tower,
so that its height may reach to heaven.
et celebremus nomen nostrum antequam dividamur in universas terras.
And let us make our name famous before we are divided into all the lands.”
Descendit autem Dominus ut videret civitatem et turrim,
Then the Lord descended to see the city and the tower,
which the sons of Adam were building.
And since they have begun to do this,
they will not desist from their plans,
until they have completed their work.
and in that place confound their tongue,
ut non audiat unusquisque vocem proximi sui.
so that they may not listen, each one to the voice of his neighbor.”
Atque ita divisit eos Dominus ex illo loco in universas terras,
And so the Lord divided them from that place into all the lands,
and they ceased to build the city.
Et idcirco vocatum est nomen ejus Babel,
And for this reason, its name was called ‘Babel,’
quia ibi confusum est labium universæ terræ:
because in that place the language of the whole earth became confused.
et inde dispersit eos Dominus super faciem cunctarum regionum.
And from then on, the Lord scattered them across the face of every region.
These are the generations of Shem.
Sem erat centum annorum quando genuit Arphaxad,
Shem was one hundred years old when he conceived Arphaxad,
two years after the great flood.
Shem lived for five hundred years,
Porro Arphaxad vixit triginta quinque annis,
Next, Arphaxad lived for thirty-five years,
postquam genuit Sale, trecentis tribus annis:
Arphaxad lived for three hundred and three years,
and he conceived sons and daughters.
Likewise, Shelah lived for thirty years,
postquam genuit Heber, quadringentis tribus annis:
Shelah lived for four hundred and three years,
and he conceived sons and daughters.
Vixit autem Heber triginta quatuor annis,
Then Eber lived for thirty-four years,
Et vixit Heber postquam genuit Phaleg,
Eber lived for four hundred and thirty years,
and he conceived sons and daughters.
Likewise, Peleg lived for thirty years,
postquam genuit Reu, ducentis novem annis:
Peleg lived for two hundred and nine years,
and he conceived sons and daughters.
Vixit autem Reu triginta duobus annis,
Then Reu lived for thirty-two years,
Reu lived for two hundred and seven years,
and he conceived sons and daughters.
In truth, Serug lived for thirty years,
Serug lived for two hundred years,
Vixit autem Nachor viginti novem annis,
And so Nahor lived for twenty-nine years,
postquam genuit Thare, centum decem et novem annis:
Nahor lived for one hundred and nineteen years,
and he conceived sons and daughters.
And Terah lived for seventy years,
And these are the generations of Terah.
Mortuusque est Aran ante Thare patrem suum,
And Haran died before his father Terah,
in the land of his nativity,
Duxerunt autem Abram et Nachor uxores:
The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai.
And the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah,
Tulit itaque Thare Abram filium suum,
And so Terah took his son Abram,
the wife of his son Abram,
et eduxit eos de Ur Chaldæorum,
and he led them away from Ur of the Chaldeans,
to go into the land of Canaan.
And they approached as far as Haran,
Et facti sunt dies Thare ducentorum quinque annorum,
And the days of Terah that passed were two hundred and five years,
and then he died in Haran.
